newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ABB sees profit growth intact.
newsitem.headline: ABB sees profit growth intact.

text.p: International engineer ABB's chief executive Goran Lindahl said on Thursday he saw no reason why the average annual profit growth of 17 percent since 1988 should not continue.
"Today I see no reason that this can't hold for the next four to five years," Lindahl told the company's annual general meeting.
However, he said 1997 would not be a strong growth year when compared to 1994 and 1995.
"Our forecast is unchanged, the net profit for 1997 will reach at least the same level as in 1996," he said.
"As stated in our annual report, we estimate that a second year in a recession is worse than the first. Therefore we expect low growth also in 1997 if you compare it to 1994 and 1995," Lindahl said.
